form.label: SOC Overview
form.description: Failed logins, top offending IPs, Suricata alerts, threat intel matches

search.query: index=main (sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4625) OR ((sourcetype="linux_secure" OR sourcetype="syslog") "Failed password") | eval source_type=if(sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security","Windows","SSH") | timechart span=15m count by source_type

index=main (sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4625) OR ((sourcetype="linux_secure" OR sourcetype="syslog") "Failed password") | rex field=_raw "Failed password for (invalid user )?(?<ssh_user>\S+) from (?<ssh_ip>\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)" | eval src_ip=coalesce(Source_Network_Address, ssh_ip) | stats count by src_ip | sort - count | head 15
index=main sourcetype="suricata" event_type=alert | stats count by alert.severity

index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" (EventCode=4720 OR (EventCode=4732 Group_Name="Administrators")) | eval account=coalesce(Account_Name, Member_Name), action=if(EventCode=4720,"Account Created","Added to Administrators") | table _time, account, action, Caller_User_Name, Computer | sort - _time

index=main sourcetype="WinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational" EventCode=4104 (Message="*-enc*" OR Message="*-EncodedCommand*" OR Message="*FromBase64String*" OR Message="*IEX*" OR Message="*DownloadString*") | table _time, Computer, User, Message | sort - _time

index=main (sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4625) OR (sourcetype="suricata" event_type=alert) | eval src_ip=coalesce(src_ip, Source_Network_Address) | lookup threat_intel.csv ip AS src_ip OUTPUT category, confidence | where isnotnull(category) | table _time, src_ip, category, confidence, sourcetype | sort - _time
